title: Flux 2 Flex
description: Text-to-image generation with FLUX.2 [flex] from Black Forest Labs. Features adjustable inference steps and guidance scale for fine-tuned control. Enhanced typography and text rendering capabilities.

pricing.text: Your request will cost $0.05 per megapixel on both input and output side, rounded up to the nearest megapixel. For example, a 1024x1024 image will cost $0.05, and a 1920x1080 image will cost $0.10 ($0.06 × 2 megapixels). Similarly, a 512x512 output will cost $0.05 ($0.05 for 0.26 megapixels, rounded to 1 megapixel).

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.tooltip: The prompt to generate an image from.

inputs.name: image_size
inputs.tooltip: The size of the generated image. 'custom' uses the width and height below.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.tooltip: The seed to use for the generation. -1 leaves it to the model.

inputs.name: safety_tolerance
inputs.tooltip: The safety tolerance level for the generated image. 1 being the most strict and 5 being the most permissive.

inputs.name: enable_safety_checker
inputs.tooltip: Whether to enable the safety checker. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked.

inputs.name: output_format
inputs.tooltip: The format of the generated image.

inputs.name: guidance_scale
inputs.tooltip: The guidance scale to use for the generation.

inputs.name: num_inference_steps
inputs.tooltip: The number of inference steps to perform.

omitted.why: yes/no sync_mode returns the file inline and drops it from fal's request history - always left off
